principles: Smallest hermetic slice that yields a verifiable gate-strength metric
Reuse the B-4c65 receipt — the strength claim is itself evidence
Prove discrimination with bracketing reference reviewers, not a single constant
Honest scope: reference reviewers now, live gate deferred
drivers: §6 recovery-runner is untracked scratch, not a capability
The metric must be provably non-vacuous

options.name: Hermetic reviewer-agnostic harness + 2 reference reviewers + verifiable receipt
pros: Ships + demos now, no live dispatch
Reference reviewers (0 vs all) prove the metric discriminates
Output is a B-4c65 receipt → offline-verifiable (composes 🥇+🥈)
cons: Measures the reference reviewers, not the LIVE gate — live-lane plug-in is a follow-up (stated honestly)

options.name: Live review-lane dispatch as the reviewer now
cons: Needs agent dispatch (claude -p) — not hermetic, heavy, slow; wrong for slice 1

options.name: Just re-run the §6 recovery-runner scratch
cons: Untracked scratch, not a first-class story-gated capability; no verifiable receipt

chosen: Hermetic reviewer-agnostic harness + 2 reference reviewers + verifiable receipt
rationale: Only this ships hermetically now, proves the metric discriminates (test-only 0 vs spec-aware all), and composes with 🥇 by emitting a B-4c65-verifiable receipt. The live review-lane reviewer plugs into the same reviewer-agnostic interface as a follow-up.

preMortem.scenario: The catch-rate is meaningless because the reference reviewer is a constant
preMortem.trigger: Only one reviewer, or both behave the same
preMortem.mitigation: Ship BOTH a test-only reviewer (must catch 0) AND a spec-aware reviewer (must catch all) — the smoke asserts the two endpoints differ, proving the harness measures real discrimination

preMortem.scenario: The gate-strength receipt is read as an Authority strong proof
preMortem.mitigation: Reuse B-4c65 assurance=local-key-single-host; the receipt + smoke + CHANGELOG state hermetic/reference-reviewer scope, live gate deferred

preMortem.scenario: Probes are too easy, overstating gate strength
preMortem.mitigation: Corpus includes obvious + subtle + buried probes; report is scoped to synthetic prompt-sized artifacts; large/diffuse probes flagged as future
